# ankra_cost_rate_card (Resource)

A cost rate card: the monthly rates that price clusters on private-cloud credentials (Proxmox, Morpheus, vSphere and MAAS), where no provider price list exists. A card set on a credential prices that credential's clusters; the organisation card (no `credential_id`) prices every private-cloud cluster whose credential has none. Changes need organisation admin. Destroy removes the card, so its clusters fall back to the organisation card, or go unpriced.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The organisation card prices every private-cloud cluster whose credential has
# no card of its own.
resource "ankra_cost_rate_card" "organisation" {
  currency                  = "eur"
  vcpu_monthly_amount       = "9.50"
  memory_gb_monthly_amount  = "2.25"
  storage_gb_monthly_amount = "0.08"
}

# A card for one Proxmox, Morpheus, vSphere or MAAS credential.
resource "ankra_cost_rate_card" "lab" {
  credential_id       = "4d3c2b1a-0f9e-4d8c-b7a6-f5e4d3c2b1a0"
  currency            = "eur"
  vcpu_monthly_amount = "6"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `currency` (String) Currency of the rates: usd, eur, gbp, sek, nok, dkk, chf, pln, czk, jpy, cad, aud, inr. Stored lowercased.

### Optional

- `credential_id` (String) Private-cloud credential the card prices. Leave unset for the organisation card. Changing it replaces the card.
- `memory_gb_monthly_amount` (String) Monthly price of one GB of memory. A decimal string, such as `"12.50"`. Defaults to `"0"`.
- `storage_gb_monthly_amount` (String) Monthly price of one GB of storage. A decimal string, such as `"12.50"`. Defaults to `"0"`.
- `vcpu_monthly_amount` (String) Monthly price of one vCPU. A decimal string, such as `"12.50"`. Defaults to `"0"`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The credential id, or `organisation` for the organisation card.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The organisation card is imported as "organisation", a credential's card by
# the credential id.
terraform import ankra_cost_rate_card.organisation organisation
terraform import ankra_cost_rate_card.lab 4d3c2b1a-0f9e-4d8c-b7a6-f5e4d3c2b1a0
```
